claims.statement: Tom Allen seconded Jem Mace in the Mace-Coburn fight near New Orleans.
claims.excerpt: aad Cusick and Fom Allea, secends fer Mace.
places: about forty miles from New Orleans

claims.statement: Tom Allen was among the prize-ring notables present at the Mace-Coburn fight.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, Ned O’Baldwin, the Irish Giaat; Tom
places: about forty miles from New Orleans

notes: Allen was a second, not a fighter, so no fight entry. The referee (Col. Rufus Hunt) declared the fight a draw after 3 hours 38 minutes; that is not an Allen fact. The hint that Allen travelled on the excursion train is not stated in the text and is dropped. OCR is garbled in places.
